answers.sql: SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P1' AND published_on <= '2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT transfer_units AS value FROM releases WHERE period='P2' AND published_on <= '2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT transfer_units FROM releases WHERE period='P2' AND published_on <= '2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1) * 1.0 / (SELECT transfer_units FROM releases WHERE period='P1' AND published_on <= '2024-07-05' ORDER BY published_on DESC LIMIT 1) * 100.0 - 100.0 AS value
